articles.title: Romania says Russian drone hit building in its territory
articles.summary: A Russian drone struck an apartment building in NATO-member Romania on the night of May 28-29, near the Ukrainian border, wounding two people. Romania's defence ministry confirmed the incident, which represents a direct violation of NATO airspace. This highlights the ongoing risks of regional spillover from the Ukraine conflict and raises concerns about security.

articles.title: The best lakes in the U.S. for a scenic summer getaway
articles.summary: Lake getaways create lasting memories through activities like wilderness canoe camping, learning to fish, or mastering wakeboarding and water skiing. These experiences offer a nostalgic connection to nature, promoting outdoor recreation and skill development in serene environments. Such pursuits contribute to personal well-being and provide memorable leisure opportunities, highlighting the importance of engaging with natural surroundings.
